title: The Lost Route
description: Elara wants to put a little-known trail onto a map so no newcomer disappears there.
completion_text: Elara finally trusts someone else to help map the island's dangerous paths.

stages.title: The Lost Route
stages.lead: Craft a map, then compare notes with Elara.
notes: A personal request from Elara. The quest is only offered through their friendship dialogue.

objectives.description: Discuss what the map should mark with Elara.
